entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return some cycling shoes, order number VF12345.
Okay, I can look that up for you. Can you tell me why you're returning the shoes?
They're just not the right fit. I wore them on one ride, and they're too tight.
I understand. To clarify, have you already mounted cleats on these shoes?
Yes, I did. I fully installed my cleats on them before realizing the fit wasn't right. You can probably see the cleat marks.
Thanks for letting me know. I also see you're trying to return some tires. Were those tires also mounted?
Yes, I put them on my bike and rode about 10 miles. They're not what I expected.

I understand. Unfortunately, because the shoes have been mounted with cleats and the tires have been installed and used, creating dirty tires, we cannot accept the return. Items that have been used, even once, cannot be resold as new, and we can only accept returns on unused merchandise.
Oh, I see. I didn't realize that applied even if I only used them briefly.

I apologize for the inconvenience. Our policy is in place to ensure all our customers receive new, unused products when they purchase from VeloFit. Perhaps you could try selling them online or donating them to a local cycling club?
Okay, that's a good idea. Thanks for the suggestion.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks for your help!
You're very welcome! Have a great day, and thanks for choosing VeloFit!
